Indikator 3 measures the proportion of assessment pathways that include a diagnostic conference across Danish regions and selected departments for the year 2024/25, comparing these figures to previous years [^src1]. The data reveals that the national target for this indicator was not met by any region or at the national level, as every entity recorded "Nej" (No) for the achieved status [^src1]. 

When examining the leaders and trailers, [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] emerged as the clear leader, achieving a 51% proportion of assessment pathways with a diagnostic conference [^src1]. In stark contrast, [[privathospitaler|Privathospitaler]] ranked at the very bottom with 0%, having conducted no diagnostic conferences out of 16 pathways [^src1]. [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] also performed poorly among the public regions, reaching only 20% [^src1]. 

Trends across the dated sections highlight significant regional disparities. While most regions experienced a declining trend compared to the previous year, [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] saw a dramatic outlier increase, jumping from 19% to 51% [^src1]. [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] also improved, rising from 16% to 26% [^src1]. Conversely, [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] dropped from 31% to 22%, and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] fell from 34% to 26% [^src1]. [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] saw a slight decline from 23% to 20% [^src1]. At the national level, Denmark's overall proportion increased slightly from 23% to 27%, though it remains well below the implied target threshold [^src1].

Summary: Tabellen viser andelen af udredningsforløb med diagnostisk konference i 2024/25 og tidligere år for regioner og udvalgte afdelinger, og viser en markant stigning i Midtjylland (fra 19 % til 51 %) og en faldende tendens i de fleste andre regioner.
